correctness.rationale: Every cubic vertex induces an edge-disjoint line-graph triangle. Conditional minima of monochromatic pairs for t favored incident edges are (1,0,1,3). The x field contributes -xt/2 per original vertex, giving a rigorous global lower bound. Proper three-edge coloring realizes each local optimum at every vertex through four color maps, so the envelope is sharp for all real x and disconnected G. At 2<x<4 the nonzero edges form perfect matchings with two independent nonzero spin choices; at x=4 they form arbitrary matchings. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 3^12 cube-line assignments gave 13 sector counts (450,1248,1044,288,24,288,912,864,144,352,168,24,1), sum=531441, with crossover counts 3054,2232,689. This finite test supports, not proves, the general result.
